title: Tutu Atwell on Rams return: I feel like I never left

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tutu Atwell on Rams return: I feel like I never left
sources.description: Wide receiver Tutu Atwell moved on from the Rams in free agency this year, so he was taken by surprise when Rams head coach Sean McVay told him that he was heading back to the team last week.
